posts.text:
so, this entire situation has been, complex to watch play out, for me, for Cleveland small world reasons.

I went to high school with Max Miller. He was a year ahead. Didn’t really know him - seemed like a rich white boy who threw parties I wasn’t invited to. Mother Jones reported on a high school “incident.” At the time I couldn’t figure out where the girl - a buddy from math class - disappeared to. I “learned” more later but it was…high school gossip. Plenty of people I knew/know knew/know Max
posts.summary: Discusses personal connection to Max Miller story, suggests further reporting
